about: The TransitFM1 releases the web installer offers, newest first (index.html installs the first). sha256 is the package's (transit-X.Y.fwsc), from the release's SHA256SUMS: tools/make_site.py refuses a package that does not match it, and the page checks it again in the browser before any write.

notes: Baud Girl installs from TransitFM1: its updater now answers as M-VAVE's (ota-FM-1_015) when the next firmware carries M-VAVE's loader, and as Felucca's (ota-FM-1_900) otherwise.
Includes 0.1.1's fixes: the safe start after the official V15, and installs no longer stalled by a DAW's MIDI.
Every installer takes it for the official V15: identity FM-1_015, the USB device "FM-1".
ChoralRoot's boot stub in front of it, and the next firmware written by its own loader, first sector last: a write cut off at any other point comes back in update mode.
Fixes 0.1's crash on its first start after the official V15: it now sets up its rescue loader safely, and shows "STAGING THE LOADER" while it does.
Fixes installs that stalled while a DAW sent MIDI to the FM-1.
